articles.title: Mimic Busters - Official Announcement Trailer - IGN
articles.summary: Take a look at the Mimic Busters announcement trailer for this upcoming stealth party game. In Mimic Busters, matches pit agents from the Mimic Bureau of Investigation against player-created props standing around the room. Hiding players start each round with an empty cube and limited time. Using basic push, pull, and paint tools, they shape the block into an object that fits the room, such as a chair, desk lamp, or bookshelf. To keep matches moving, all hiding players automatically emit a squeak sound every 30 seconds, giving away audio clues.Mimic Busters will be available on PC via Steam in 2026.
